answer: Cluster-scaled bonding charges a sybil farm per fake key squared. The ledger links keys with on-chain ties, such as a vine of vouches between them or one payout inlet collecting their rewards. Each key locks 100 POA times n, the size of its linked cluster: a lone agent locks 100 once, while each of 1,000 tied clones locks 100,000, or 100 million total. Random audits re-grade 2% of each key's work per epoch; one failed audit burns the whole cluster's bonds, so no key can harbor a fake without sharing its risk. Weakness: unlinked singletons evade this but lose all coordination.
